comments.body: @julianoes I wrote in https://github.com/Dronecode/DronecodeSDK/issues/718#issue-429710976 what I had to do to get a successful build with latest visual studio. Although just the build ran through and some tests failed but I'm not sure what should actually work since I'd probably need to have SITL running.
For the unit tests SITL doesn't need to be running.
@MaEtUgR but why am I seeing the errors above? And why does appveyor build just fine: https://ci.appveyor.com/project/Dronecode/dronecore/branch/develop/job/r6y86f94c340wqx5
So the problem here was the dinamic linked libraries not being in the correct folder which get copied on appveyor?
I don't know about this one. It only happens on my Windows at Home.

issue.title: core: fix MSVC compiler error

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
Somehow, on one machine these changes were needed in order to avoid MSVC complaining about:
```
warning C4346: 'iterator': dependent name is not a type
```
